nh15e01.title: Aries arrives two hours early
nh15e01.caption: Two hours early, tinsel on everyone, zero chill. Then Aries slowed down for the part that matters: the hello. Who in your family always shows up way too early?

nh15e02.title: Taurus gives the buffet tour
nh15e02.caption: Taurus gave a full museum tour of the buffet, then did the unthinkable: handed over the last slice of pie. From a Taurus, that's a love letter. Who gets your last bite?

nh15e03.title: Gemini wrote three family guides
nh15e03.caption: Guide A: Dad loves sports. Guide B: never mention sports. Guide C: Dad is a cat person. Dad just said come in, it's cold. Gemini, how many drafts are you on?

nh15e04.title: Cancer already has a stocking
nh15e04.caption: Cancer paced the porch rehearsing every worst case. Mom had already stitched a stocking with the date's name on it. Tag the Cancer who worries before every hello.

nh15e05.title: Leo planned an entrance
nh15e05.caption: Leo planned the entrance of the year and lost the spotlight to a baby's first steps. Then Leo cheered the loudest. Who's the best supporting star in your family?

nh15e06.title: Virgo made a family binder
nh15e06.caption: Virgo made a tabbed, laminated family binder. The date read it twice and remembered Aunt Bea's tea and the dog's birthday. Is studying for someone the most romantic move?

nh15e07.title: Libra has to pick a pie
nh15e07.caption: Two grandmas, two pies, one Libra swinging like a pendulum. The Aries date found the only right answer: seconds of both. Pumpkin or cherry, which side are you on?

nh15e08.title: Scorpio hid the baby photos
nh15e08.caption: Scorpio hid the baby album under a cushion. Mom had copies. One tiny dinosaur photo later, the date traded a tiny lobster. Would you show your baby pictures this early?

nh15e09.title: Sagittarius said "my family's chill"
nh15e09.caption: Sag promised a chill family and opened the door on a conga line. Then Sag offered a code word for a quiet break, no questions asked. What's your exit word?

nh15e10.title: Capricorn fixes the whole house
nh15e10.caption: Capricorn fixed the lights, the wobbly table and the squeaky door before sitting down once. Grandma had to say it: you're home. Who needs to hear that this year?

nh15e11.title: Aquarius warns about the traditions
nh15e11.caption: Dessert first, gifts wrapped in star maps, and good night to the moon from the roof. The Leo didn't just fit in, it started a new one. What's your family's weirdest tradition?

nh15e12.title: Pisces brings someone home
nh15e12.caption: Pisces cried at the wreath, the doormat and every hallway photo. The Capricorn date handed out tissues, then let one perfect tear fall too. Who cries with you?
